entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ahhh. This is the perfect way to refill after[n]some training.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, the track team's up and runnin'[n]again. Yamauchi got taken down pretty[n]quick.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You know Takeishi's mom is the PTA prez,[n]right? He told her everything.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: After that, she came stormin' in with the[n]other parents and forbid the whole[n]scoutin' plan.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wish I coulda seen the look on Yamauchi's[n]face. I mean, the school can't ignore[n]the PTA.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And as a result, the track team's back.[n]Our old coach's fillin' in for now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, it serves that dick right! What a great[n]feelin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think they might even go far in the meet.
I'm looking forward to it.[clr 27]
We can't lose either.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw crap, the ramen's gonna get soggy.[n]Let's eat!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Phew, that was awesome...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: To tell the truth, I was scared of facin' those[n]guys straight up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I couldn't stand how much they hated me.[n]It only just made me think of how stupid[n]I was...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Most of all, it made me remember how[n]I lost my place with them.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, this ain't like me, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I managed to change 'cause you were here[n]helpin' me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I got you all wrapped up in this shit,[n]but you stayed with me 'til the bitter end.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...You didn't abandon me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... thanks, man.
You're welcome.
It's all because of you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hahaha...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...It's funny, huh? This started out as us[n]trainin' for the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How'd it end up like this?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Either way, it's my turn now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If anything comes up, you tell me. I'll help[n]you with whatever you need.
I feel a strong bond with Ryuji...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can feel it... My new power!
Ryuji's Persona [clr 1]Captain Kidd[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Seiten Taisei[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! Now I have that off my chest,[n]let's do this!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: First up: the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'll be countin' on you, Leader. And you[n]can count on me too!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, now that we're all fueled up, wanna[n]race to the station?
